evals.prompt: I want to build a new React SaaS dashboard for a B2B analytics platform. The target audience is mid-level managers at tech companies who need clean data visualization. We need real-time updates via WebSocket, and the design should feel modern and professional. Can you help me get started?
evals.expected_output: Asks the 5 starter questions, proposes a feature-based or layer-based project structure tailored to a SaaS dashboard, and explains how the signature design style (dynamic grid, depth layering, color philosophy) would apply to an analytics dashboard.

assertions.text: Asks all 5 starter questions (purpose, audience, animation/real-time, APIs, design feeling)
Proposes a project structure (feature-based or layer-based)
Mentions signature design principles (depth layering, dynamic grid, color philosophy, or motion with purpose)

evals.prompt: Build me a React user profile card component with a modern dark theme. Use TypeScript, make it performant, and style it with our signature glassmorphism + neumorphism depth layering style. The card should show an avatar, user name, role, and a 'Contact' button with hover animation.
evals.expected_output: A Functional Component + TypeScript component with custom hooks if needed, memoization applied where appropriate, signature styling with backdrop-filter and box-shadow layering, Framer Motion for the hover state, and a clear 1-primary + neutral + 1-accent color scheme. No Material Design or Tailwind UI templates.

assertions.text: Uses useCallback or useMemo for performance
Includes glassmorphism/neumorphism styling (backdrop-filter, box-shadow, or layered depth)
Has hover animation (Framer Motion or CSS transition)
No Material Design or Tailwind UI template patterns

evals.prompt: I have a React component that fetches user data from an API and displays it. Here's the code: [provide a sample component with dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no CSRF protection, inline functions in JSX, and an exposed API key in env]. Please review it for security vulnerabilities and performance issues.
evals.expected_output: Performs a Security Vulnerability Scan finding XSS (dangerouslySetInnerHTML), exposed secrets, CSRF issues, inline function re-renders, and other problems. Reports findings in the specified format (Name, Severity, Location, Impact, Fix Options) and waits for approval before fixing.

assertions.text: Identifies exposed API key or secret
Uses specified report format (Name, Severity, Location, Impact, Fix Options)
Waits for approval before implementing fixes
